SELECT t.id, t.account_id, t.card_id, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.transaction_region, t.amount, t.balance_after, t.merchant_name, t.merchant_type, t.memo, t.category_id, t.original_amount, t.applied_exchange_rate, t.currency_id, sc.category_name, COALESCE(a.account_name, c.card_name) AS payment_method_name, t.category_source, t.category_confidence, t.category_classified_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = t.category_id WHERE t.id = #{transactionId} AND (a.user_id = #{userId} OR c.user_id = #{userId}) AND t.is_deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (card_id, external_key, transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_type, transaction_region, amount, balance_after, merchant_name, merchant_type, original_amount, applied_exchange_rate, currency_id, category_id, category_source, category_confidence, category_classified_at) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{externalKey}, #{transactionDate}, #{transactionTime}, #{transactionType}, #{transactionRegion}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantType}, #{originalAmount}, #{appliedExchangeRate}, #{currencyId}, #{categoryId}, #{categorySource}, #{categoryConfidence}, #{categoryClassifiedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), card_id = VALUES(card_id), merchant_name = VALUES(merchant_name), merchant_type = COALESCE(VALUES(merchant_type), merchant_type), transaction_region = VALUES(transaction_region), amount = VALUES(amount), original_amount = VALUES(original_amount), applied_exchange_rate = VALUES(applied_exchange_rate), currency_id = VALUES(currency_id), category_id = IF(category_source = 'USER', category_id, VALUES(category_id)), category_confidence = IF(category_source = 'USER', category_confidence, VALUES(category_confidence)), category_classified_at = IF(category_source = 'USER', category_classified_at, VALUES(category_classified_at)), category_source = IF(category_source = 'USER', category_source, VALUES(category_source)), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.card_id, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.transaction_region, t.amount, t.balance_after, t.merchant_name, t.merchant_type, t.memo, t.category_id, t.original_amount, t.applied_exchange_rate, t.currency_id, sc.category_name, t.category_source, t.category_confidence, t.category_classified_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = t.category_id WHERE t.card_id = #{cardId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND t.transaction_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.transaction_time DESC
